task.description:
Fix runtime SQL errors in src/entities/commands.zig and ensure integration tests pass.

1. Wrap createRecord in a transaction (try conn.begin() and defer reset on error).
2. Add explicit type casts to the SQL in updateProjection: $1::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::jsonb, $5::bigint, $6::integer.
3. Verify if tenant_id and record_id strings are being handled correctly as UUIDs by the pg driver.
4. Ensure all integration tests in tests/integration/entity_subsystem_test.zig pass.

Note: PgError.ServerError is being thrown from conn.exec in updateProjection.
acceptance_criteria: SQL syntax handles UUID/BIGINT types properly

result.summary: Fixed runtime SQL errors in updateProjection by adding explicit casts and ensured atomicity with transaction wrapping in createRecord. Verified all integration tests pass (12/12).
